prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up shot of a person’s hands holding a modern digital camera, with the focus on the camera’s LCD screen displaying a menu of video recording formats, including options like “XAVC S 8K” and “XAVC S 4K.” The hands are positioned naturally, fingers gently gripping the camera body and adjusting settings. The background is softly blurred with a shallow depth of field, featuring large, circular bokeh lights in cool blue and white tones, suggesting an urban night scene. The lighting is low and moody, with soft highlights reflecting off the camera and hands, creating a cinematic, intimate atmosphere. The overall color palette is cool and subdued, dominated by blues and blacks, with the warm glow of the camera screen providing a subtle contrast. The composition is tight and immersive, drawing attention to the tactile interaction with the camera and the anticipation of capturing high-quality video.
